status_definitions.FRESH: Observed timestamp is within target freshness.
status_definitions.LAGGING_WITHIN_MAX: Observed timestamp missed target freshness but remains within maximum allowed age.
status_definitions.DELAYED_SOURCE: Free or public source is known to be delayed or daily, but still inside the allowed maximum age.
status_definitions.LATEST_OFFICIAL_RELEASE: Official macro source is evaluated against release cadence, not real-time market freshness.
status_definitions.STALE: Observed timestamp exceeds maximum allowed freshness and must carry a warning.
status_definitions.SOURCE_GAP: No usable source row was obtained; do not infer a value.
